# AtroUI

> AtroUI is a production React / Next.js component library and dark-first design system.
> Site: https://www.atroui.com
> Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/atroui
> Repo: https://github.com/atroui/atroui

## Install

```bash
npm install atroui
```

```tsx
import { Button, ThemeProvider } from "atroui"
import "atroui/globals.css"
```
